title: Built-in Wardrobe quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: 2.7m wide x 2.4m high built-in wardrobe with 3 mirrored sliding doors. Internal split: half hanging (double rail) and half shelving + 4 drawers. Melamine internals.
workingDetail: MDF sheets, Melamine boards, Hanging rails, Drawer runners

conversation.request: Hey Mate, got a built-in wardrobe here, two point seven metres wide and two point four metres high, with three mirrored sliding doors, half double-rail hanging and half shelving plus four drawers, all melamine internals – can you get a quote sorted?
conversation.mateAck: Good one. I'll sort a Built-in Wardrobe quote for you now.
conversation.clarifyingQuestion: Just to confirm — what's the internal depth for the wardrobe?
conversation.clarifyingAnswer: Yeah, make it six hundred millimetres deep, Mate.
conversation.matePricing: Sweet — pricing it up now with live supplier rates…
conversation.reveal: Here's the quote — a two point seven metre wide built-in wardrobe with three mirrored sliding doors, half hanging, half shelving, four drawers, all with melamine internals, and a six hundred millimetre depth.

presenter.reaction: That's the lot — real prices and everything. Sorted.
presenter.setting: A tradie stands in a partially renovated bedroom, overlooking a suburban backyard with a newly laid patio.
